entities.name: André Rienzo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Albanez Rienzo is a Brazilian former professional baseball pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago White Sox and Miami Marlins. Rienzo represented Brazil in the 2013 World Baseball Classic, and currently serves as the pitching coach for the Brazil national baseball team as well as a pundit for baseball matches on ESPN Brasil. Rienzo was the first Brazilian-born pitcher to start and win an MLB game.
